Doom engine and base game assets

Unmodified binaries and Freedoom 0.13.0 assets from danborden1/doom-web at e0ba81004e27e7d66141925dfebb091a558e2fe8.
https://github.com/danborden1/doom-web/tree/e0ba81004e27e7d66141925dfebb091a558e2fe8

Engine: GPL v2; COPYING included. Corresponding source is included as engine-source.tar.gz, from https://github.com/Saketh-Chandra/doom-wasm-pwa/tree/a77edfd8bbc7 (a Chocolate Doom / cloudflare/doom-wasm fork). Build instructions are in that archive.

Freedoom game data: BSD 3-clause; FREEDOOM-COPYING.txt and FREEDOOM-CREDITS.txt included. No commercial Doom game data is bundled.
